rca of the issue: N/A - STEP 1 blocker is resolved. The refactor from formState.isValid gating to await trigger() on-click gating removed the RHF isValid proxy subscription flakiness. Every step's Continue button now (a) is always enabled visually, (b) on click awaits methods.trigger() which forces the async zod resolver to compute per-field errors AND aggregate isValid, and (c) advances only if ok, else pushes a toast. This is the standard pattern for RHF multi-step wizards and completely sidesteps the earlier flake where isValid stuck at false after Controller onChange fired on schema-valid values.
